capabilities: scan notes for scripture references in Book Chapter:Verse format
write and update a single index file
remove stale index entries when notes are deleted or renamed
index files automatically after edits with a configurable delay
exclude specified files and folders from indexing
extras: The README documents the expected citation syntax (Book Chapter:Verse, hyphen for intervals, commas and semicolons for multiple references) and all settings, but links to no external documentation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to collect scripture citations scattered across notes into one up-to-date index.
summary: Scripture reference indexer that scans notes for citations like Gen 1:1-5 and writes them into a single index file.
